messages:
Lina: Uploading draft capability matrix for EdgeBank RFP — need engineering + security answers before EOD. File attached. @Raj @Ana @Jules :pray:
attach-bot: file uploaded: EdgeBank_Capability_Matrix_DRAFT.xlsx (link: https://redwood.app/files/abc123)
Raj: Quick Q — will they require Private (VPC) or Dedicated? That changes our pricing.
Lina: They marked "private preferred" in questionnaire but open to hybrid POC.
Mike: Can we confirm POC sizing? Example:
```
POC: 3 months
Reserved: 2x A10G
Target qps: 100
Rollout: canary 10% -> 100%
``` 
Ana: Dedicated vs Private: Dedicated = reserved GPU pool (we manage infra), Private = customer VPC / on-prem with private control plane. Private adds infra onboarding time (~2-4 wks).
Raj: Also need to know quantization support — 4-bit vs 8-bit and fallback model variants. Any perf numbers?
Ana: We recommend q4f16 for cost/perf; q8 for highest perf. Perf gist: q4 ≈ 1.8x cost reduction vs fp16 on typical LLMs, latency ~+10%.
Jules: Security: they asked about SAML SSO, SCIM, KMS, HSM options. Legal wants SAML and KMS + SOC2 mention. No FedRAMP asked.
Raj: For KMS line: `Customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/Azure KeyVault) — supported; HSM option via add-on` — can someone confirm HSM status?
Ana: HSM is available in Private via partner integration (requires SOW). Mark as 'available upon request'.
Lina: I'll add that. Mike — can you draft the pricing rows and POC acceptance criteria? We need per-token, reserved commit, and support SLA lines.
Mike: On it. Drafting now, will post a table snippet shortly.
attach-bot: file uploaded: EdgeBank_POC_SOW_outline.pdf (link: https://redwood.app/files/def456)
Mike: Draft snippet:
```
Pricing:
- Hosted API per-token (gen): $0.0025/1k tokens
- Dedicated reserved commit: $X/mo per GPU (TBD)
- Private deployment: license + infra (SOW)
Acceptance:
- 95percentile latency < 250ms for 512 tokens
- Throughput 80qps sustained
```
Raj: I'll add a tech blurb for quant & routing to the matrix. Lina please confirm final by 4pm PST so I can send to them before COB.
Lina: Thanks team — aim for 3pm so we have time to incorporate legal notes. :thumbsup:
Mike: I'll consolidate answers + attach final pack to Google Drive and ping the RFP contact. ETA 4:30pm PST.
Lina: Perfect. Appreciate it.
